environment: Cloud Linux Chromium browser, actual unmodified web dashboard
scope: Desktop dashboard screenshots only; no native macOS shell or mobile validation
capture_method: Supported cua_repl browser screenshot API; original JPEG screenshots re-encoded as PNG with identical decoded RGB pixels. Overview and incident views used the normal browser zoom control at 80% and the screenshot API viewport clip to exclude capture overscan. No retouching, CSS changes, or UI text changes.
runtime_limits: Official HTTP fixture mode used (RADIO_BROWSER_TEST_TLS=0). HTTPS-only live websocket rejects this origin, so Reconnecting and zero operators are expected.
Only the dashboard server ran. Worker and sync services were not started; fixture heartbeats became stale and health warnings remain visible.
No production recordings, private accounts, models, external services, or hosted CI were used.
No browser security warning bypass or trust-store changes were made.
Screenshots document inspected UI states, not a complete regression-test pass.
